news.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin president Matt Prusak departs for Giga Energy
news.summary: The executive is leaving the Eric Trump-backed miner to join an AI power infrastructure firm, highlighting the shift toward energy and data center buildout.

news.title: U.S.-Japan intervention revives yen carry trade fears for bitcoin
news.summary: Coordinated action sent the yen sharply higher, but bitcoin’s recent correlation suggests U.S. dollar strength, rather than the carry trade, may be the bigger risk.

news.title: Circle slides after Morgan Stanley downgrade, cut in price target
news.summary: The bank said tokenized money market funds, Open USD and slower USDC growth could weigh on the stablecoin issuer's earnings.

news.title: Bernstein sees another leg lower for crypto markets if Clarity Act stalls
news.summary: The broker said failure to pass the Clarity Act this year would likely send crypto lower, but expects U.S. regulators to accelerate rulemaking.

news.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash with new blockchain-based money market offerings
news.summary: Both funds intend to qualify as eligible reserve assets for permitted U.S. payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.

news.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine bought more ether, added to stock buyback last week
news.summary: Chairman Tom Lee said ether's outperformance versus the Nasdaq in July signals strengthening crypto fundamentals.

news.title: Strategy sold another $105 million of bitcoin last week, repurchased $81.2 million of STRC
news.summary: The company trimmed bitcoin holdings by 1,638 coins, while raising $290.6 million with sales of common stock.

news.title: Bitget set to exit Japan, close all remaining positions by year-end
news.summary: The crypto trading platform, ranked fifth on CoinGecko, stopped accepting new registrations on Sunday and plans to shut down all remaining positions by Dec. 31.

news.title: Why the U.S. decided to help Japan by boosting the flailing yen
news.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department and Federal Reserve have joined forces with their Japanese counterparts to stage a historic joint intervention to boost the Japanese yen, according to Japan’s Ministry of Finance, which confirmed the move in a statement on Monday.

news.title: Disappointed by your skimpy pay raise? Blame your healthcare benefits.
news.summary: It’s been two decades since companies’ health-benefit costs have climbed this fast.

news.title: ‘My head hit the driver’s window’: A teenager T-boned our car. Will Medicare pay my hospital bills?
news.summary: “My car was nearly 20 years old, and I only carried liability and uninsured motorist coverage, not collision coverage.”

news.title: Why tech stocks are likely to take a back seat for the rest of 2026, according to JPMorgan strategists
news.summary: Strategists at the bank see non-U.S. shares performing well in the second half of the year and prefer semiconductor stocks to hyperscalers.

news.title: They spent tens of thousands of dollars on home remodels — only to regret it. ‘It’s just been so much.’
news.summary: Some homeowners spend big bucks to upgrade their house, only to end up having second thoughts.

news.title: My boss and I work in different cities and she never responds to my messages. What do I do?
news.summary: “Most of the time it feels like I’m just talking into the ether.”

news.summary: “I expect to have several years before I take distributions from my 401(k) account.”
